tagline: Club y campo de golf en la ciudad de Santo Domingo

areas.casa_club: Main clubhouse building with restaurants, event salons and social spaces.
areas.pabellon_recreativo: Recreational Pavilion with family-oriented recreational facilities, in addition to the Casa Club.

activities.description_en: 18-hole golf course redesigned by Bowman Design, considered one of the best in the Caribbean.
activities.description_es: Campo de golf de 18 hoyos rediseñado por Bowman Design, considerado uno de los mejores del Caribe.

activities.description_en: Tennis courts available for members, with the Casa Tenis dining spot nearby.
activities.description_es: Canchas de tenis disponibles para socios, con el área de Casa Tenis cerca.

activities.description_en: Padel courts available as part of the club's racquet sports offering.
activities.description_es: Canchas de pádel disponibles como parte de la oferta de deportes de raqueta del club.

activities.description_en: Swimming pool area with poolside food and drink service (Piscina menu).
activities.description_es: Área de piscina con servicio de comidas y bebidas (menú de Piscina).
Instalaciones de gimnasio FitCorner para socios.

activities.description_en: Racquetball courts available at the club.
activities.description_es: Canchas de racquetball disponibles en el club.

hours.note_en: General club hours; individual venues and sports may have their own schedules.
hours.note_es: Horario general del club; áreas y deportes individuales pueden tener su propio horario.
